name: 個人会話の見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH03-0001「個人会話の見出し」.
Create a polished raster redesign of the single compact conversation header, using the first image as the precise layout/content reference. The second image is the original WhatsApp screen: only its header is relevant; preserve the roles of back, avatar, participant name, video call, and voice call. The third image is approved Lighthouse styling only: white rounded surfaces, delicate neutral border, very subtle soft downward shadow, refined restrained depth.
Composition: landscape 3:1 white canvas. Center ONE horizontal header strip, keeping the original 390:64 component proportions, all controls in the same sequence and relative spacing. Plain pure white #FFFFFF surroundings. Do not add a device, screen, title, description, chat history, status bar, labels, duplicated variations, or any extra controls.
Exact component contents from left to right: slate back chevron; circular white avatar with fine neutral outline and the single Japanese character「山」in forest green; exact name「山田 はるか」; slate outline video camera; slate outline telephone handset. Keep name on one line, aligned to the same center as icons.
Typography: preserve the verified Meiryo Bold 14px /24px line height at logical 390px width, tracking 0. Avatar initial has its established small size. Scale every dimension uniformly for the output; do not inflate the name to a new 20px heading role. Body proportions and spacing follow image 1.
Color decision: original header uses a turquoise avatar as identity decoration with black call icons. Existing mock changed avatar to mint. Adapt it to a white outlined avatar with forest-green initial; supporting controls all coherent slate #526173. There is no selected, warning or primary action state here, so do not invent a colored call button. Use #1D1D1D name, white surface, quiet neutral outline. The bus image's green gradient is brand context, not a requirement to fill this quiet utility header. No mint fill, random per-icon colors, blue action, heavy gloss or ambient green glow.
Show complete sharp Japanese glyphs and clean aligned 1.5px logical outline strokes. Preserve every actual control and the compact readable hierarchy. This is a design candidate image, not an interactive implementation.
reviewNotes: 原画面・原画面参照記録・保存モック・ネイティブ文字設定を確認。元の水色アバターは装飾的な識別であり、白い輪郭円と森林緑の山へ適応。戻る・映像・通話は統一スレート。生成画像を目視し、山田 はるか、山、全4操作とアバター、白面・細枠・控えめな影を確認。出力は若干横長で、正確なネイティブ寸法や書体一致・操作・所有者承認は未確定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
